name: Deadly Strike (Su)
body:
Benefit(s): The ninja can focus on a specific attack, applying more than one of her deadly techniques to it. The ninja may apply two tricks she knows that apply to sneak attacks (*) to the same sneak attack. Each use of this ability uses up 1 ki point.

Ultimate Options: Power of the Ninja © 2011, Rogue Genius Games, LLC; Author: Owen K.C. Stephens.
